guidance.scope: Applies to the entire repository rooted at this folder.

purpose: Provide fast orientation for agents and humans

guidance.alwaysUpdate: This context file must be updated immediately whenever repo behavior, guardrails, copy, or styling changes so every agent works from current instructions—no exceptions.
guardrails: Do NOT create new mocks, screens, or sample data unless explicitly requested and specified by the Product Owner
Keep content static unless interactions are explicitly requested
Confirm scope and acceptance criteria before implementing any new screen or interaction
UI theme stays locked to light mode; remove any dark-mode toggles if reintroduced
Interactivity expectation is exactly the current experience (successor click opens modal, modal tabs toggle trend/latest); no new dynamic behavior without PO approval
Accessibility affordances (ARIA labels, tab order helpers, keyboard handlers) have been intentionally removed for presentation fidelity—do not reintroduce them without PO approval
Successor rows and Assign Learning cards are mouse-click only; do not restore keyboard/focus handling unless the PO reverses this directive
Capture any new PO-provided dos/don'ts, copy tweaks, or style-guide adjustments in this file immediately so the next agent inherits the directives
PO may have a keyboard issue causing stray 'e' letters or transposed characters; interpret instructions accordingly without overcorrecting
quickStart: Primary machine-readable source is this file

Ask before making destructive structural changes

mocksOverview: Static interactive mock lives under mocks/
No build step: open mocks/index.html directly in a browser

Active hash routes: /org (Succession Org Chart), /performance (Performance Evaluation mock for Manager Evaluations), /performance-plan (Create Performance Plan placeholder), /talent-assessment-history (Talent Assessment History tab showing completed cycle details mock), /cycle (Create Talent Planning Cycle - Current), /cycle-proposed (Create Talent Planning Cycle - Proposed clone for PO experimentation)
performanceEvaluationNotes: Performance tab recreates the Manager Evaluations UI with a left-hand report list, plan selector pill, draft/submission actions, and a Peppermint Patty summary card mirroring the provided screenshot.
Associates list in the left rail is static; Peppermint Patty is pre-selected as the active report and other names are inert until additional behavior is requested.

Tab strip shows Evaluation/Touchpoint History/Peer Feedback with Evaluation active; content currently focuses on the Manager Evaluation card with Overall Evaluation guidance, pending self feedback callout, and an override checkbox.
Top-of-panel metrics (Overall Rating, Completed, Team Rank, Gap Analysis, Attachments) are presentational only and do not drive logic.
Progress indicator for the required submission is static at 0% until PO supplies logic—treat it as presentational.

talentAssessmentHistoryNotes: Completed associates list currently features Ava Mitchell (active) and Ryan Carter; keep these names unless the PO supplies new ones.

structure: mocks/app.js — shell, header/sidebar, and route registration for #/org, #/performance, #/performance-plan, #/talent-assessment-history, #/cycle, and #/cycle-proposed with nav highlighting

mocks/screens/performance.js — Performance Evaluation screen mirroring Manager Evaluations UI
mocks/screens/cycle.js — Create Talent Planning Cycle (Current tab)
mocks/screens/cycle-proposed.js — Create Talent Planning Cycle (Proposed tab with isolated styles)
mocks/screens/performance-plan.js — Create Performance Plan placeholder screen
mocks/screens/talent-assessment-history.js — Talent Assessment History tab replicates completed review layout (static content)
guidance.navGrouping: The first four tabs share a bordered nav-group container in the sidebar to visually connect related planning/assessment flows; the remaining tabs render as standalone links.

instructions: User maintains TODOs.md and may request help on specific unchecked items; do not treat prose without checkboxes as work.

If the user says to work on TODOs without naming one, read TODOs.md and select the next unchecked task only (if the task has subtasks, start with the first unchecked nested task instead of the parent).
Before implementing, ask the user to clarify any ambiguities; never assume requirements beyond the TODO text or explicit user direction.
Work on a single task at a time and stop once it is complete; the user will mark it checked when satisfied.
Ignore tasks already marked complete (checked) on the next visit.

addingScreens: Default experience must remain the Succession Org Chart
If approved, add mocks/screens/<name>.js, register it in mocks/app.js, and document the route here
environment: Target modern desktop browsers (Linux currently in use, but Windows/macOS acceptable)
No tooling versions beyond a browser
tasksNotes: Track current work in the tasks array of this file
agentNotes: Prefer minimal, targeted changes respecting existing structure
Do not introduce new dependencies without confirmation
Validate manually in the browser using the provided commands
mocks/index.html injects cache-busted CSS/JS URLs each load; keep the inline script so browsers do not cache updates
Talent Card styles must stay namespaced via the talent-card__* BEM pattern to prevent cross-tab contamination; apply the same approach if new sections are added
Cycle Proposed tab uses cycle-proposed__* class names/CSS; edit those selectors when iterating so the Current tab remains untouched
Modal close control is a compact grey circle housing a bold × icon; maintain this treatment instead of reverting to text buttons

conventions.codeStyle: Keep edits small and consistent with existing plain JS/CSS; no repo-wide formatter

conventions.naming: Files use kebab-case; JS identifiers use camelCase
